budget_speed.note_en: Budget speed is 1200 kg/hr (printed in the footer of both slides)

stilstand.definition_nl: Extruder staat stil (rood blok), of extruder snelheid wordt terug genomen wegens een storing elders in de lijn.
stilstand.definition_en: Extruder is stopped (red block), or extruder speed is deliberately reduced because of a fault elsewhere in the line. Both cases: WEL stilstand, GEEN slow running.

slow_running.definition_nl: Wat is de reden dat er niet meer gemaakt kan worden tijdens normale productie?
slow_running.definition_en: Steady output below the budget speed during normal production, without a stop or registered fault. The shortfall vs budget is the slow-running loss.

classification_rules.scenario_nl: Shredder vast; extruder stopt in hetzelfde venster, daarna weer 1200 kg/hr
classification_rules.scenario_en: Shredder jammed; extruder stops for the same window, then resumes at 1200 kg/hr

classification_rules.scenario_nl: Wanneer de extruder snelheid wordt terug genomen (bijv. wegens storing/shredder vast) is dit geen slow running
classification_rules.scenario_en: When extruder speed is deliberately throttled back (e.g. due to a fault / shredder jam), this is not slow running

classification_rules.scenario_nl: Extruder draait de hele dienst op 1000 kg/hr terwijl budget 1200 kg/hr is
classification_rules.scenario_en: Extruder runs the whole 8-hour shift at 1000 kg/hr against a 1200 kg/hr budget

symptoms.symptom_nl: Slow running: output blijft onder budget snelheid (1200 kg/hr) tijdens normale productie, zonder stilstand
symptoms.symptom_en: Slow running: output stays below budget speed (1200 kg/hr) during normal production, without a stop

causes.cause_nl: Shredder brengt niet genoeg (extruder silo leeg)
causes.cause_en: Shredder does not deliver enough (extruder silo empty)
Extruder filter change interval too short
Extruder at maximum RPM (screw speed ceiling reached)

notes: Source slides define slow running and list possible causes; they do not prescribe remedies or detailed check procedures. 'checks' entries are restatements of each cause's observable, 'remedy' is null where the source gives none.
Handwritten annotation on Slow_running.pdf panel 2: 'storing' (fault) with pen hatching over the throttled extruder segment.
Slides are CeDo / Newton training material; legend colours: green = Output/Snelheid, red = Stop, orange = Slow running.
